_설명: 영어 대사 규칙 - TTS 발음 위험 + AI 티·번역투(2026-11-09, 전부 경고. 결과 보고 오류로 올릴지 정함). 사람이 판단할 것은 en.md "AI 티 · 번역투". scripts/check-text.py가 씀, 고치면 python3 scripts/check-text.py --selftest

rules.msg: 괄호·기호는 TTS가 읽거나 이상하게 끊음 - 말로 풀어 쓰기
bad: Temüjin (later Genghis Khan) rode out.
good: Temüjin, the future Genghis Khan, rode out.

rules.msg: 줄임말 - TTS가 철자로 읽을 수 있음, 풀어 쓰기 (c. → around)
bad: He was born c. 1162.
good: He was born around 1162.

rules.msg: 대문자 줄임말 - TTS가 철자로 읽음 (강조라면 소문자로)
bad: They did NOT stop.
good: They did not stop.
In 1223 AD.

rules.msg: 로마 숫자 - TTS 읽기 확인, 필요하면 audio/pron.json
bad: Muhammad II fled.
good: Muhammad the Second fled.

rules.pattern: \b(?:is|are|was|were|does|do|did)n['’]t (?:just|only|simply|merely)\b|\bnot (?:just|only|simply|merely)\b|\b(?:is|are|was|were)n['’]t (?:a|an|the|about)\b[^.!?]*[.!?]\s+(?:it|that|this)(?:['’]s| is| was)\b|\b(?:it|that|this)(?:['’]s| is| was) not (?:a|an|the|about)\b[^.!?]*[.!?]\s+(?:it|that|this)(?:['’]s| is| was)\b
rules.msg: "X isn't just Y. It's Z" 틀이 편에 2번 이상 - 챗GPT 글의 대표 틀. 훅에서 한 번이면 두고, 끝맺음에서 되풀이하지 않기 (그냥 Z라고 말하기)
bad: Diabetes isn't just too much sugar. It's a key that stopped turning.
It's not a pipe filling up. It's a plaque breaking.
The Mongols weren't only fighters, but builders.
good: Diabetes is a key that stopped turning.
Many cells can't just let sugar in.
It isn't much. But it stays.

rules.msg: "Here's the strange part" 같은 예고 문구 - 놀랍다고 말하지 말고 바로 놀라운 사실을 말하기 (쇼츠 여러 편에 똑같이 나옴)
bad: Here's the strange part. Those needles can sit there for years.
And here's the catch: these plaques often don't narrow the artery.
This is where it gets interesting.
good: Those needles can sit there for years, and you won't feel a thing.
Here's how they did it.
Here's the plan.

rules.msg: 소수점까지 정확한 숫자에 about·around - 정확하면 그대로 말하고, 어림이면 둥근 수로 (about 7.74 million → 7.74 million 또는 nearly 8 million)
bad: Worldwide, about 7.74 million people live with it.
Above about 6.8 milligrams per deciliter, it crystallizes.
good: Worldwide, 7.74 million people live with it.
Nearly 8 million people live with it.
About 2.5 million people.
Nearly 80 percent of cases.
fixes: Worldwide, about 7.74 million people live with it.
Worldwide, 7.74 million people live with it.
Above about 6.8 milligrams per deciliter, it crystallizes.
Above 6.8 milligrams per deciliter, it crystallizes.

rules.msg: 한 문장에 어림말(about·roughly·nearly…) 두 번 - 사람은 한 번만 어림하고 나머지는 딱 잘라 말함 (번역하면 "정도…쯤"이 겹침)
bad: On average, about 116 in your twenties, and about 75 past seventy.
It holds about one teaspoon, and a bowl of rice brings roughly ten times that.
good: On average it's 116 in your twenties and 75 past seventy.
It holds about one teaspoon. A bowl of rice brings ten times that.

rules.msg: 숫자 앞 어림말(about·around·nearly…)이 편에 너무 많음 - 출처가 추정치인 것만 남기고, 놀라운 숫자는 딱 잘라 한 번 (TTS로 들으면 about이 계속 들림)
bad: About nine in ten don't know they have it.
good: Nine in ten don't know they have it.
Almost all of it goes back.

rules.msg: "So how/why…?" 질문으로 장을 여는 틀이 편에 많음 - 같은 틀 질문은 훅 하나·장 하나 정도, 나머지는 바로 사실로 시작
bad: So why don't you feel it?
But how do tens of thousands of horsemen cross a desert?
good: Why the big toe? That still isn't settled.
So he looked to another kingdom.

rules.msg: 장소 먼저 + 동사 + 주어 뒤집기("At the edge of the desert stood a small town")가 편에 많음 - 동화책 말투이고 한국어 어순(장소 먼저) 그대로. 주어부터: "A small town sat at the edge of the desert."
bad: At the edge of the desert stood a small town.
Just behind your stomach sits a large gland, the pancreas.
good: A small town sat at the edge of the desert.
Your pancreas sits just behind your stomach.
In 1215, they lay the planks over the moat, then crossed.

rules.msg: "The result? …" 한 낱말 질문 뒤 답 - 편에 2번 넘으면 AI 글 틀. 한 번만, 나머지는 그냥 문장으로
bad: The biggest reason? The Jin controlled the trade.
good: The biggest reason was trade.
What was the reason?

rules.msg: 쉼 넣으려고 문법에 없는 쉼표 (의문사와 조동사 사이, 주어와 동사 사이) - 영어 원어민 눈엔 오타. 쉼은 대본의 / 표시로
bad: So how, did Genghis Khan get ready for war?
The Mongol invasion of the Jin, continues in part two.
good: So how did Genghis Khan get ready for war?
The story continues in part two.
Where, exactly, did they go?
fixes: So how, did Genghis Khan get ready for war?
So how did Genghis Khan get ready for war?
The Mongol invasion of the Jin, continues in part two.
The Mongol invasion of the Jin continues in part two.

rules.msg: AI 글에 유난히 많은 낱말 (delve·tapestry·pivotal·utilize…) - 유튜버가 말로 쓰는 쉬운 말로
bad: Let's delve into the siege.
It was a pivotal moment.
They utilized siege engines.
A rich tapestry of cultures.
good: Let's dig into the siege.
It was the turning point.
They used siege engines.

rules.pattern: \b(?:a testament to|it['’]s worth noting|it is worth noting|it['’]s important to note|it is important to note|needless to say|little did (?:they|he|she|anyone) know|the rest is history|changed the course of history|(?:a )?stark reminder|stark contrast|in the annals of|sent shockwaves|a force to be reckoned with|shrouded in mystery|stood the test of time|let['’]s dive in(?:to)?|buckle up|fast forward to|at its core|in a world where|nothing short of|can(?:not|['’]t) be overstated|forever changed|the stage was set|a perfect storm|in order to|played a (?:crucial|pivotal|key|vital) role)\b
rules.msg: AI·다큐 상투구 (a testament to, it's worth noting, little did they know, the rest is history…) - 빼거나 구체적인 사실로
bad: His victory was a testament to his genius.
It's worth noting that the Jin had walls.
Little did they know, the Mongols were watching.
They dug in order to drain the moat.
good: His victory proved how good he was.
The Jin had walls.
The Mongols were already watching.
They dug to drain the moat.
fixes: They dug in order to drain the moat.
They dug to drain the moat.

rules.msg: 긴 대시(em dash·en dash) - AI 글 리듬이고 TTS 쉼이 들쭉날쭉. 쉼표·마침표로 (채널 규칙: 긴 대시 안 씀)
bad: He rode out — and never came back.
The walls held–for a while.
good: He rode out, and never came back.
fixes: He rode out — and never came back.
He rode out, and never came back.

rules.msg: 문장 끝에 ", a dangerous cycle."처럼 평가 꼬리표 - AI가 자주 붙이는 해설. 빼거나 한 문장으로 ("…and the cycle starts again.")
bad: And that pressure damages them again, a dangerous cycle.
He attacked at night, a bold move.
good: And that pressure damages them again. The cycle feeds itself.
He made a bold move.
